description: DEX swap quote (Uniswap v3). Best Uniswap v3 single-hop quote for swapping amountIn of tokenIn to tokenOut on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum or Optimism, checking all fee tiers (0.01/0.05/0.3/1%). Returns amountOut, effective price, best fee tier, gas estimate. Tokens: ETH, USDC, USDT or 0x address. Read-only quote; no swap is executed. Deterministic, no LLM. Example output: {"chain":"base","tokenIn":"WETH","tokenOut":"USDC","amountIn":"1","amountOut":"2325.41","price":2325.41,"feeTier":500,"gasEstimate":"90000","venue":"uniswap-v3"}. Price: $0.0045 USDC on Base via x402 (pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]).
name: dex_quote
